description: This file contains the implementation of the MembershipTableManager class, which manages the membership table in Orleans runtime. It handles membership updates, health checks, gossiping, and node status transitions, and interacts with the membership table provider, gossiper, and lifecycle components.

classes.name: MembershipTableManager
classes.description: Manages the Orleans membership table, including node status updates, gossip, and failure detection.

classes.name: MembershipTableManager.SuspectOrKillRequest
classes.description: Represents a request to suspect or kill a silo, used in internal processing channels.

classes.name: MembershipTableManager.WithoutDuplicateDeadsLogValue
classes.description: A struct used for logging the membership table without duplicate dead entries.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Initializes the membership table and performs initial node migration detection.

methods.name: UpdateIAmAlive
methods.description: Updates the current node's liveness status in the membership table.

methods.name: UpdateStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of the current silo (e.g., Active, Dead, ShuttingDown).

methods.name: TryUpdateMyStatusGlobalOnce
methods.description: Attempts to update the local silo's status in the membership table atomically.

methods.name: ProcessTableUpdate
methods.description: Processes and publishes updates to the membership table snapshot.

methods.name: CleanupMyTableEntries
methods.description: Cleans up outdated or inconsistent entries related to this silo.

methods.name: KillMyselfLocally
methods.description: Marks the local silo as dead and triggers fatal error handling.

methods.name: GossipToOthers
methods.description: Gossips the current silo's status to other silos.

methods.name: ProcessSuspectOrKillLists
methods.description: Processes queued suspect or kill requests for silos.

methods.name: InnerTryKill
methods.description: Attempts to mark a specific silo as dead in the membership table.

methods.name: InnerTryToSuspectOrKill
methods.description: Attempts to suspect or kill a silo based on votes and membership data.

methods.name: DeclareDead
methods.description: Marks a silo as dead in the membership table and propagates the change.
